summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX plan for the Record Label CEO & Full Roster Artist Ecosystem, enabling the player to manage signed roster artists with custom names/avatars, independent stats (Popularity, Fans, Hype), physical paper recruitment contracts, dedicated Staff Teams, full Songwriting/Album Studio production & discographies, Spotify/RIAA/Pitchfork/Metacritic profile switchers, an Official Record Label YouTube Channel for roster MVs/Lyric Videos/Visualizers, and an Official Record Label X (Twitter) Account switcher.
